metadata.title: Oracle Stock: Jefferies Says ‘Peak Negative’ Sentiment Points to  Earnings Beat<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Software Stocks Are Rallying on Earnings: Is Oracle Next?
Software stocks are back in vogue, and the more beaten-down the better. That may bode well for Oracle when it reports earnings next week.
